_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Yu wokim Klondike Solitaire. Yu lakim muvim olgeta kad i go long foundation piles.

Rul bilong Game:
- Foundation piles (F1-F4): Bildim antap long Ace i go long King long suit
- Tableau piles (T1-T7): Bildim daun long alternating kala (red i go antap long black, black i go antap long red)
- Stock: Drawim kad i go long waste pile
- Waste (W): Kad i stap antap long en i ken pley

Komand:
- 'draw' - Drawim kad long stock i go long waste
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Muvim kad namel long piles
  Eg: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count i ken tu 'all', bai i traem muvim olgeta kad i stap we open.
- 'forfeit' - Pinisim game kwiktaim na lukim skor bilong yu
- Nem bilong pile: W (waste), F1-F4 (foundation), T1-T7 (tableau)

Yu ken wokim planti action long wanpela turn bai yu skelim ol long komma:
  Eg: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

King tasol i ken stap long tableau pile i no gat kad.
Action i wokim long oda - sapos wanpela i no wok, bai ol arapela action i no wok tu.
Yusim 'forfeit' sapos yu bilivim game i no inap win.

format_error.no_brackets: Dispela tok i no stret. Em mas stap insait long brackets (olsem ol hap bilong en).
format_error.no_closing_bracket: I no stret long wokim dispela tok. ']' i stap yet na em bai pinis taim yu putim mak bilong en ""
format_error.empty_command: Komand i no gat samting. Taip 'draw' o 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.empty_action: Wok i no gat wok long en
format_error.move_needs_args: Movim komando i mas gat ples bilong kisim na rot. 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.count_invalid: Kaunt i no stret. Usim namba o 'all'
format_error.unknown_command: Komanda i no save '{cmd}'. Yu usim 'draw', 'move <source> <destination> [count]', o 'forfeit'

action_result.before_failure: Em i bin mekim {n} wok bilong em paslain long ol samting i no kamap.

move_result.drew: Ol i kisim ol dispela samting long han bilong ol na tromoi.
move_result.cannot_draw: Ol i no inap pulim mani, ol samting bilong baim na pipia tu.
move_result.invalid_pile: Nem bilong planti samting i no stret. Yusim W, F1-F4, o T1-T7
move_result.foundation_one_card: Inap putim wanpela kat tasol long ples bilong wokim haus.
move_result.waste_to_foundation_ok: Kirap long ol pipia samting na go insait long haus F{dst}
move_result.waste_to_foundation_bad: I no inap putim ol karis i go long dispela hap bilong sait.
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_ok: Muvim kad long tableau T{src} i go long foundation F{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_bad: I no inap long putim wanpela kat bilong tabloim i go insait long dispela hap.
move_result.foundation_to_foundation: I no inap go long narapela hap bilong haus.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_one_card: Inap putim wanpela kat tasol long ol samting nogut na i go insait long plet.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_ok: Kirap long ol samting nogut na go long tablo T{dst}
move_result.waste_to_tableau_bad: I no inap putim ol karis i lus long dispela hap bilong tebol.
move_result.no_face_up: No gat ol kat i stap antap bilong karim.
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_ok: Muvim {count} kad(s) long tableau T{src} i go long T{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_bad: No ken muvim {count} kad(s) long T{src} i go long T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_one_card: Inap putim wanpela kat tasol long ples bilong wokim ol samting na kisim i go insait long plet.
move_result.foundation_empty: F{src} i no gat man long en.
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_ok: Muvim kad long foundation F{src} i go long tableau T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_bad: I no inap putim foundation card long tableau T{dst}
move_result.to_waste_or_stock: I no inap go long ol pipia o stok samting.

outcome.forfeit: Gem i lus. Skor bilong yu: {score} kadi long ples bilong faundesen.
outcome.won: Mi tok amamas long yu, nau yu winim Klondike Solitaire!
outcome.turn_limit: Gem bai finis! Yu rikim makisim {max_turns} torn. Skor: {score} kard i go long foundation.
